[id 100]
First friend rang the bell 20 times.
Second friend rang the bell 20 / 4 = 5 times more than the first friend.
So, the second friend rang the bell 20 + 5 = 25 times.
Third friend rang the bell 10 more than the third friend.
Fourth friend rang the bell 60 times.
Let the third friend rang the bell x times.
Then x = 60 + 10 = 70.
Total rings = 20 + 25 + 70 + 60 = 175.

Total pages to read = 4 + 20 + 7 + 8 = 39 pages.
Pages read in 5 days = 15 pages.
Remaining pages = 39 - 15 = 24 pages.
Days to read remaining pages = 4 days.
Pages to read per day = 24 / 4 = 6 pages.

Dimensions of each box are 5 inches x 6 inches x 4 inches.
Outer dimensions of each box are 5+2*1=7, 6+2*1=8, 4+2*1=6.
Volume of each box is 7 * 8 * 6 = 336 cubic inches.
Volume of 3 boxes is 3 * 336 = 1008 cubic inches.
Since the walls are 1 inch thick, the inner dimensions are 5x6x4, and the inner volume is 5*6*4 = 120 cubic inches.
The inner volume of 3 boxes is 3 * 120 = 360 cubic inches.

[id 108]
Let y be the number of cookies Henry made last year.
This year, he wants to make 2y cookies.
He actually made 2y - 15 cookies.
He has 2y - 15 + 5 = 2y - 10 cookies now.
2y - 10 = 110
2y = 120
y = 60
Therefore, Henry made 60 cookies last year.
